Needs changes before merge. SAFETY-tier review: two blocking collision defects. The PR also conflicts with current main.

Requested before merge:

1. **P1: Check both changed endpoints after an open curve reverses.** `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/curve.rs:666` checks a column only when that endpoint has an explicit pick. A start pick can also change the exit. That new exit has no column check.

   Reproduction: use the existing 40 x 40 x 15 box and a 6 mm ball. Add a canopy box from `(2, -8, 18)` to `(8, -1, 20)`. Use the open drive curve `[(5, 0, 7.5), (35, 0, 7.5)]`. Set only the start pick to `(36, -1)`, with the existing `cp()` heights and default axis control. The planner returns `Ok`. Its last move is a rapid from `(5.03, 0, 7.5)` to `(5.03, 0, 25)`, under axis `[0, -1, 0]`. The ball centre has Y = -3. The retract crosses the canopy. An explicit exit pick at `(4, -1)` makes the same path refuse, which confirms the omitted check.

   Check the actual plunge and retract columns of each curve changed by either pick. Add pins for a start-only reversal and an exit-only reversal. Preserve the automatic path when neither pick is present.

2. **P1: The column samples can miss a complete obstruction.** `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/curve_seam.rs:286` uses fixed 0.25 mm samples without a conservative bound between them. A small ball can cross a thin canopy without touching any sampled sphere.

   Reproduction: use the existing box and `ring()`, with `tool_diameter = 0.1`, clearance Z = 25, default axis control, no shank, and only exit pick `(20, -0.001)`. Add a canopy box from `(15, -0.1, 18.12)` to `(25, -0.001, 18.13)`. The planner returns `Ok`. The last rapid runs from tip `(19.98, 0, 7.5)` to `(19.98, 0, 25)`, under axis `[0, -1, 0]`. Its ball centre has Y = -0.05. The canopy stands between the samples at Z = 18.0 and 18.25. The continuous retract crosses it.

   Use a continuous swept check or a conservative bound between samples. Refuse the path if the sample limit prevents a safe bound. Add a small-cutter pin with an obstruction between samples.

3. **Refresh the branch against current main.** The final merge check against `83d52ef6a283497e00a1a13c8403ee4671cd7795` found a content conflict in `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:400`. The earlier trial merge was clean. Resolve this conflict and run the required checks on the refreshed head. I aborted the failed merge and retained the tested worktree.

The existing verification does not replace these guards. The envelope scan omits rapid moves (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/scan.rs:325`). The stock rapid law does not convict an upward vertical retract (`crates/sim/src/verify/rapids.rs:122`).

Local results (the successful trial merge below; the latest-main merge cannot build until its conflict is resolved):

- Successful trial merge base: `267ee5096bde18de7c82f18bc93c041a773baa97`. Trial head: `78878bc3e3eff7d58d1d6a2169acd3d63be908c6`. Its first parent is the reviewed PR head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 216 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. Both selected crate builds passed.
- Motion `multiaxis`: 19 passed. App `start_exit_shared`: 18 passed, including the new generation and MCP undo/redo pins.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The two temporary clearance assertions failed because the unsafe paths returned `Ok`. They were removed after the checks. The restored `multiaxis` suite passed all 19 tests. The failed assertions were:

```text
the start pick reverses the run and retracts through the canopy at x=5
a 0.1 mm ball retracts through the canopy at z=18.12..18.13
```

Extra suites run:

- App `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored.
- App `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- App `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- No fixture or importer changed. The extra kernel suites do not apply.

Mutations repeated locally, one at a time:

| Mutation | Pin | Result |
|---|---|---|
| M5: disable the open-start reversal | `curve_picks_on_an_open_curve_select_its_ends` | RED: the cut starts at the wrong end |
| M3: disable the picked plunge-column check | `curve_picked_columns_under_a_canopy_are_refused_by_name` | RED: the blocked plunge returns no error |
| Restore the source | full motion `multiaxis` suite | GREEN: 19 passed |

The moved unit tests match the previous source after indentation changes. No recorded program or golden changed. No UI file changed. Full heavy lanes were not run, as required for this P2 review. The compile cache stopped responding during the first attempt. The completed runs used the local compiler with that cache disabled. No runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The author's agent stopped work on this PR when the maintainer took it over. Nothing was pushed to this PR branch. The unpushed review-fix work is on a side branch for reuse:

https://github.com/qsmits/Camcraft/compare/issue/3330-multiaxis-curve-picks...handoff/4050-review-fixes

- `cb6413799`: merge of main. The conflict in `mcp/tools.rs:400` was two additions to the same `edit_operation` help string. Both are kept.
- `956b146bf`: the fix for both review findings.
  - Finding 1: `Seated::columns()` gives the plunge and the retract column of each curve that took either pick. `curve.rs` refuses each blocked column by name. A curve with no pick is unchanged. Pin: `curve_a_pick_that_reverses_an_open_curve_checks_both_columns` (both reviewer cases are refused).
  - Finding 2: `column_clear` uses the exact segment-to-facet distance (`stock_sim::dist_seg_tri`) with a box prefilter, not 0.25 mm samples. Pin: `curve_a_small_ball_cannot_pass_a_thin_canopy_between_samples` (the reviewer's 0.1 mm case is refused).
  - Mutations: R1 (each column judged only by its own pick), R2 (plunge judged only by a start pick) and R3 (0.25 mm samples again) each turn a pin red.
- `6a0e67237`: a clippy fix (a NaN distance still refuses the column).

The merged Contour5D code (#4006) does not have the sampling gap: its pick columns and overhang trim already use the exact `dist_seg_tri`.

Gate: on `956b146bf` only. 194 steps, 0 failed (after a temporary local copy of the #4064 fix), and the light lane passed. No gate ran on `6a0e67237`. The verify gaps that this work does not change: the envelope scan omits rapids (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/scan.rs:325`), and the stock rapid law does not check an upward retract (#4062).

@qsmits @NeoTech: we can help finish this one. The plan: start from qsmits's `handoff/4050-review-fixes` branch (it already has the merge of main), close the two collision findings of the safety-tier review of `8d61b24d9` with tests that fail without the fix, gate it, and push to this PR (maintainer edits are allowed). It stays clear of the Parallel5D slice in #4084.

The comments say the maintainer took this PR over, so we won't start until one of you says OK here, or tells us that someone else already has it.
Withdrawn: the maintainer has this PR, so we're staying off it. No reply needed.
These would need to be checked against the Path kernel work before merging. A large portion of that motion kernel rework is due to issues like this was created in the past..
Closing them for now - as they may or may not be superceeded by path kernel work.
